answer.answer: Yes. Fern CI has now published its retention period: the updated FAQ states that Fern CI retains build logs for 30 days (fern-faq-new). This supersedes the earlier FAQ snapshot, which stated that the build-log retention period was not specified (fern-faq-old). Both snapshots belong to the same FAQ lineage for subject fern-ci, so the newer statement is treated as current and the older statement as historically valid but superseded. Note that the published period is specific to build logs; no retention information for other data types is provided, and no effective date for the 30-day policy is given.
